items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: he said, okay you pick up ten tunes and you arrange them for two basses and I do so.

ctx.x: It’s too much. So I dared, I knew Ray at that time but I dared to call him and he was coming to Paris a few days after that. And I said, “Ray” I said, “Raymond” I used to call him Raymond. I said, “Raymond I’ve got to ask you a question” I said, “but please don’t be mad at me.” He said, “No, what is it?”
